guestTeacher.description: Dignified Bangladeshi male teacher around 65; grey hair and small beard, no spectacles; faded sage kurta with modest stitched shoulder tear/frayed cuff; charcoal trousers, worn sandals and old brown cloth shoulder bag. Four intact isolated poses: seated tea-glass contact, open-hand conversation, bending to notebooks, smiling with generic coins. Warm hand-inked illustrated series style.
